scope: First warmup stopped at an obsolete protocol assertion; not a throughput comparison
reason: constructor_requests are execution work, not committed mutations; existing completion changes legitimately remove requests

raw_sample.scope: standalone Cell CPU; real process wall and inference timing; not native egglog
raw_sample.path_policy: equal-length executable/input links and numeric output names
raw_sample.process_wait: blocking waitpid with a separate timeout watchdog; no polling sleeps

timing_accounting.process_unattributed_seconds: wall minus load, setup, inference and export; includes report construction, output, teardown and other unmeasured intervals
timing_accounting.report_seconds: reported runtime.report and report additions before export; absent for old binaries, never imputed as zero
timing_accounting.process_after_report_residual_seconds: process_unattributed_seconds minus measured report_seconds; only available when report is measured; includes serialization/output, teardown and other unmeasured intervals
timing_accounting.interpretation: Residuals are differences of measured intervals, not isolated measurements of serialization or drop; medians of separate phases need not sum to median wall

query_workers.scope: source-Run Cell point queries; borrowed slots and constructor domains; ordered RHS unchanged

samples.allocation_status: not_collected_normal_build; absence is not zero allocations

sieve.scope: complete visible-table semijoin summaries; not Cell-only proof credit

report_extension.scope: Extra report parsing occurs after measured child termination; frozen base harness is unchanged
report_extension.allocation_policy: Normal timing records missing allocation metrics explicitly; allocation diagnostics are separate

semantic_invariants: exact state and logical Run signatures passed before the assertion; committed unions, function updates and created facts match; unchanged native sum validator passes
resolution: Retain the failed warmup; require committed effects exactly, retain request changes as work, then start the complete predeclared interleaved campaign in a fresh directory.
